basics.name: Martin Birkenbaum
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience specializing in platform and infrastructure development. Proven expertise in designing, building, and deploying scalable backend services, cloud-native microservices, and GitOps-driven automation systems within AWS environments. Passionate about enhancing developer productivity, CI/CD, observability, and clean code practices.

work.name: Initech Corporation
work.summary: Led architecture and development of high-throughput microservices and GitOps-driven infrastructure pipelines.
highlights: Designed and implemented Python-based event-driven microservices processing 10M+ daily events, contributing to scalable backend systems
Standardized containerized deployments utilizing Docker, Kubernetes, and GitOps workflows, enhancing CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code practices
Mentored 6 junior/mid-level engineers, establishing local code styling and testing standards, and fostering operational best practices
Developed custom internal toolchains that reduced CI pipeline execution times by 40%, significantly improving developer productivity and deployment efficiency

work.name: Hooli Inc.
work.summary: Backend engineer focused on building RESTful APIs, developer tooling, and automated deployment integrations.
highlights: Developed robust REST APIs in Python/Django and TypeScript/Node.js, contributing to scalable backend and distributed systems
Integrated third-party APIs and automated webhook processors for external developer platforms, enhancing system integrations and reliability
Implemented a suite of unit and integration tests raising coverage from 60% to 92%, improving code quality and system reliability
